final_message:
The yen receipt test now passes, and the full suite is green (18 of 18).

The bug was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, so 500 yen printed as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit. I added a small zero-decimal currency set containing `JPY`, and amounts in those currencies are now printed as they are.

`formatMoney` is shared, so invoice lines and cart totals now show yen correctly too. They had the same bug. No other tests use yen, so nothing else changed in the test results.
